candidate.name: Downstream-Victim-Aware Entry Release v1
candidate.mechanism: At each forced Entry Release, simulate the actual Native LRU victim set V(X) for each legal candidate X on the same eligible state; score X by the future-reuse risk of V(X), using only pre-decision active follow-up chains and tool-gap state; release the lowest-risk candidate; tie-break to A0.
inputs: active follow-up chains and pending tool gaps
evidence_basis: Phase 4 requirement to target the actual downstream victim set

tasks: Implement deterministic Native-LRU victim-set simulation on the existing decision state.
Replay DVA_ER_V1 offline against A0 on the pre-registered existing 7 real decisions.
Reject future-feature leakage; use only pre-decision state.
Compare full-trajectory loss, not local score sums.
Record decision divergence, victim-set divergence and complete-chain evidence.
If no positive/divergent case, do not freeze the candidate and do not run formal.
